<div style="text-align: center;">

# Kimaya D. Lacey, B.S.
![](WBL_1243.jpg){width=50%}


A Master of Public Health student interested in maternal
health, health equity, healthcare operations, and health policy.

Her work focuses on understanding how healthcare systems can
better support underserved populations and improve maternal
and population health outcomes.


::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="33%"}

###  Maternal Health

Research focused on prenatal and postpartum care, maternal mortality,
and healthcare access.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

###  Data & Biostatistics

Using data visualization and statistical methods to examine
public health problems.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

###  Healthcare Systems

Exploring healthcare operations, policy, and strategies to improve
patient outcomes.

:::

:::
